description: Snowflake Scripting loop control flow in anonymous BEGIN...END blocks, asserting the COMPUTED result rather than merely that the block parses: a bare LOOP ... END LOOP exited by BREAK, CONTINUE skipping the rest of an iteration so only the even values of 1..10 are counted, BREAK leaving a WHILE loop early, and a plain WHILE that runs to completion accumulating a running total. Complements the cursor-FOR and procedure-body loop coverage elsewhere, which never asserts loop EXECUTION. Converted 1:1 from scripting/LoopBreakContinueTest (now retired); the blocks are written on one line here, which the scripting parser reads identically.

steps.sql: BEGIN LET counter INTEGER := 0; LOOP counter := counter + 1; IF (counter >= 5) THEN BREAK; END IF; END LOOP; RETURN counter; END;
BEGIN LET i INTEGER := 0; LET evens INTEGER := 0; LOOP i := i + 1; IF (i > 10) THEN BREAK; END IF; IF (MOD(i, 2) = 1) THEN CONTINUE; END IF; evens := evens + 1; END LOOP; RETURN evens; END;
BEGIN LET i INTEGER := 0; WHILE (i < 100) DO i := i + 1; IF (i = 7) THEN BREAK; END IF; END WHILE; RETURN i; END;
BEGIN LET i INTEGER := 0; LET total INTEGER := 0; WHILE (i < 5) DO i := i + 1; total := total + i; END WHILE; RETURN total; END;
